Walkthrough

The system certificate chain option now defaults to enabled. CA bundle selection prioritizes an explicitly configured bundle, then uses the system certificate file when available, and falls back to bundled certificates. Unit tests cover these selection cases and remove the previous expectation that the system certificate file is not used unless explicitly requested. **Possibly related PRs** - [honeybadger-io/honeybadger-ruby#858](https://github.com/honeybadger-io/honeybadger-ruby/pull/858): Replaces the bundled certificate file, which this change uses as a fallback. **Suggested reviewers:** `stympy`
**Change:** Feature
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to 65acc

The change makes the host's system certificate file the default CA source, with an explicit bundle taking precedence and bundled certificates as a fallback. Hosts with an outdated system file can disable the system chain to keep the bundled certificates. No actionable merge risk remains.
